sloka: तस्य जज्ञे ततः श्रीमानायुः पुत्रो महाबलः ।नहुषो यस्य पुत्रस्तु बभूवेन्द्रसमद्युतिः ।। ७.५६.२७ ॥
transliteration: tasya jajñe tataḥ śrīmānāyuḥ putro mahābalaḥ ।nahuṣo yasya putrastu babhūvendrasamadyutiḥ ।। 7.56.27 ॥

translations.english: Then to him was born a glorious and very powerful son named Ayus, whose son, Nahusha, became one with splendor equal to Indra.
